metadata.description: Agent skills for Heroes of the Storm modding: Storm documents, Galaxy script, data and UI XML, custom game modes, MPQ, CASC, replays and read-only client observation.

plugins.name: storm-modding
plugins.description: Make Heroes of the Storm mods and custom game modes: document structure, Galaxy script, data XML, UI layouts, and replacing a built-in single-player map.

plugins.name: storm-archives
plugins.description: Read and build Heroes of the Storm files: MPQ archives, the installed CASC game data, and .StormReplay replays with Blizzard heroprotocol.

plugins.name: heroes-client
plugins.description: Observe a running Heroes of the Storm client read-only with HeroesClientSDK: screens, map loading, match clock, launch results.
